notes: Primary source: RGB Spectrum official data sheet (QuadView-UHDx-Data-Sheet.pdf, rev QVUHDx09142020), cross-checked against Markertek's retail spec table (matches exactly) and ManualsLib excerpts of the user manual. Video output HDMI carries embedded audio, so it is not double-counted as a separate audio port. The 6x 3.5mm audio inputs correspond one-to-one with the 6 video inputs (4 HDMI + 2 DisplayPort) per the datasheet's "Audio: 6x 3.5mm mini-pin, stereo" input spec. LAN (RJ45) port: not itemized in the official datasheet's port table, but confirmed present via secondary sources (used for the built-in web GUI and Telnet control) and visible as a distinct connector on the rear-panel photo printed in the datasheet; direction set to bidirectional per convention. RS-232 is DB9 serial, used for third-party control. AC power connector type is not stated in text specs (only "100-240 VAC/50-60Hz, 15W max" given); the rear-panel photo in the datasheet shows a standard rectangular IEC-style inlet consistent with a compact 1RU AV unit, so "iec" (C13/C14 family) is inferred rather than confirmed from a text label — flagged as medium-confidence on that one port only. No USB ports are documented on this base QuadView UHDx model (a separate "QuadView UHDx KVM Multiviewer" variant exists with USB/KVM extension ports, which is a different SKU not covered here). Grades: HDMI ports set to hdmi-2.0 and DisplayPort to dp-1.2 per explicit datasheet spec ("4x HDMI(2.0), 2x DisplayPort(1.2)"). RJ45 and RS-232 left without a grade since no Ethernet speed is stated (RS-232 is not a graded connector type in the given scale).
